subtitleNullable: The most reviewed albums on RateYourMusic.com (as of 3/11/22)
descriptionNullable:
### Context

I was interested in web scraping, so I learned how to harvest data using R and decided to gather data from the popular music review website RateYourMusic/Sonemic as a way to practice collecting and cleaning data.


### Content

This data is from the website's Custom Charts feature, where I filtered for the most reviewed albums on the sight, and pulled all 125 pages (5,000 albums). I included 2 files: one is the raw data frame right after it was harvested (if anyone wants to practice cleaning data) and the other is after I cleaned it up a bit (for usability and analysis).


### Inspiration

These are some of the questions I had that inspired me to do this project:
Which genre has the widest range of scores?
Is the distribution of album scores normal or skewed?
How does the average rating of albums described as, say, "melancholic", compare to the average rating of albums described as "noisy"?
